artifacts.description: Posterior estimates and sampling diagnostics for every model parameter.

brief.difficulty_explanation: The agent must fit a probabilistic model, distinguish numerical output from scientifically defensible convergence, and leave auditable diagnostics.
brief.instruction: Fit the supplied Bayesian model and report posterior estimates. Create results/posterior_summary.csv with parameter, mean, r_hat, and ess columns, and results/convergence.json with an overall status. Report converged only when every R-hat is at most 1.01 and every effective sample size is at least 400.
brief.research_context: Reliable convergence assessment is necessary before posterior estimates can support a scientific conclusion. This task tests whether an agent can produce both a result and the diagnostic evidence needed to trust it.
brief.solution_explanation: Run the supplied model with multiple chains, compute posterior summaries, and derive the overall convergence state from all parameter-level diagnostics.
brief.title: Assess Bayesian posterior convergence
brief.verification_explanation: The verifier checks the result schema, numerical convergence thresholds, and consistency of the reported overall status. Independent review still assesses scientific adequacy.

checks.description: The posterior summary has the required scientific diagnostics
checks.expert_guidance: Confirm that the reported parameters and diagnostics are appropriate for the fitted model.

checks.description: Every sampling chain satisfies the R-hat convergence threshold
checks.expert_guidance: Consider whether R-hat is sufficient for this model and sampling geometry.

checks.description: Every parameter has adequate effective sample size
checks.expert_guidance: Assess whether the chosen ESS threshold is scientifically adequate for downstream use.

checks.description: The agent reports an overall converged result
checks.expert_guidance: Cross-check the overall claim against the parameter-level diagnostics.
